expected_text_segments:
SINGLE-SOURCE REPORT - REUTERS | Reuters' 21 October IBM report: software revenue growth outlook and the deal-timing test

Why it matters: Kavanaugh told Reuters that approximately 25% of transaction-processing revenue reflected deals postponed from the second quarter; he described the other 75% as new business.

Context: If Reuters' account is accurate, delayed transactions contributed to the quarter alongside new business.

Read the full brief: https://capitalchronicle.substack.com/p/single-source-report-reuters-reuters

Analysis, not financial advice. Readers decide whether to trade.

Capital Chronicle may hold positions in the markets it covers.

media_manifest.alt_text: Reuters' 21 October IBM report: software revenue growth outlook and the deal-timing test. Reuters reported a higher lower bound for IBM's annual software revenue growth outlook on 21 October 2026. Its account of deferred deals leaves a question about repeatable demand.
